title: Engineering Leads Signal Bridge - 2028-01-09
content:
Meeting: Engineering Leads Signal Bridge
Date: 2028-01-09 10:00-11:00 PT (Weekly)
Location: Zoom / #lead-signal Slack channel
Facilitator: Ava Martinez
Note-taker: Marcus Chen
Attendees: Ava Martinez, Marcus Chen, Lena Petrova, Ravi Patel, Noah Gallagher, Priya Singh (prod), Omar Ruiz (serving-runtime), Mei Yao (platform), Claire Dunn (SRE)

Agenda (tailored):
  1) Quick metrics pulse (5m) — observable regressions / surprises
  2) Active risk & blocker triage (15m) — cross-team escalation path
  3) Upcoming rollouts & canaries (15m) — smoke criteria and rollback triggers
  4) Capacity and budget signal (10m) — Dedicated pools + ephemeral bursts
  5) Decisions & action capture (10m)

1) Metrics pulse (lead: Claire)
  - 99th latency for hosted text-gen has an intermittent bump to 2.4s (baseline: 1.9s) over past 36h on us-west-2 region. Correlated with higher-than-usual long-context requests from a single customer sandbox.
  - Error rate (5xx) overall steady at 0.18% but elevated on model-variant v1.12 for batch sizes >8 (0.9%). Root cause suspected: a regression in batching threshold logic from runtime PR #981.
  - Embedding pipeline throughput is hitting target (4.2k/s) but memory fragmentation on one Dedicated pool causing GC pauses.
  - Actionable note: enable per-customer prefix caching for the sandbox tenant temporarily to reduce long-context pressure (Priya + Omar).

2) Active risks & blockers (lead: Ravi)
  - Blocker A: Platform autoscaler misreports available GPU slots when mixed P2/P3 instances are present. Impact: delayed autoscale decisions resulting in transient queuing. Confirmed tickets: JIRA-INF-2345, JIRA-CLD-1103. Owner: Mei to lead investigation; Mei to produce root-cause by 2028-01-12.
  - Risk B: Upcoming quantized model rollout (q8/llama-4) scheduled 2028-01-15 lacks perf regression tests for short prompt tail latency. Risk: latency regressions on chat workloads. Mitigation: require short-tail microbench suite run in staging + canary at 5% traffic. Owner: Omar.
  - Risk C: Observability retention cost spike in December put us near budget guardrail. Product asks for tighter alerting thresholds on hot routes. Decision: reduce day-0 retention to 7d for debug traces by default; opt-in longer retention for on-call triage. Owner: Lena, actioned by 2028-01-20.

3) Upcoming rollouts & canaries (lead: Omar)
  - Runtime PR #981 (batching thresholds) is merged to main and in canary (10% traffic) since 2028-01-08. Canary smoke criteria: no >15% increase in 99th latency, no >0.5% increase in 5xx. Current canary signals: 99p +12% on one fleet. Decide to hold rollback and reduce canary to 5% while team investigates commit. Owner: Omar and runtime on-call.
  - Dedicated pool resize for enterprise partner XCorp planned 2028-01-12 to add 4x A100s. Preflight checklist done except KMS key rotation verification. Owner: Mei.
  - Private deployment GA checklist: security review outstanding on audit logging format — security to confirm by 2028-01-16. Owner: Claire + Security.

4) Capacity and budget signal (lead: Priya)
  - Observed 18% month-over-month increase in inference tokens across hosted tier; growth concentrated in a set of 5 customers (sandbox + two PLG power users). Action: sales/growth to coordinate usage review and consider reserved capacity upsell for heavy tenants. Owner: Priya/GTM liaison (Rashid).
  - Immediate throttle recommendation: apply soft rate limit for sandbox tenant during peak 08:00-11:00 PT until prefix cache is enabled. Owner: Priya.

5) Decisions & action capture
  - Decision 1: Rollback policy for runtime batching change — hold rollback for now, reduce canary to 5% and run targeted stress tests with batch sizes 4-16. Owner: Omar. Due: 2028-01-10 EOD.
  - Decision 2: Short-tail latency test requirement for any quantization rollout — must include 95/99p microbench. Owner: Runtime + Applied ML. Due: 2028-01-13.
  - Decision 3: Adjust observability retention default — reduce day-0 trace retention to 7d, document opt-in path. Owner: Lena. Due: 2028-01-20.

Action Items (captured):
  - Priya & Omar: Enable per-customer prefix caching for sandbox tenant and monitor 99p latency (target: <2.05s). Due: 2028-01-11.
  - Mei: Investigate autoscaler misreporting for mixed instance pools and deliver RCA. JIRA-INF-2345. Due: 2028-01-12.
  - Omar + Runtime team: Run stress tests for batching thresholds across fleet types (A100, H100, T4). Add results to Confluence. Due: 2028-01-10.
  - Lena: Update observability retention defaults and doc opt-in flow. Create migration communication to SRE + CS. Due: 2028-01-20.
  - Marcus: Draft post-mortem template for recurring signal-bridge incidents and circulate. Due: 2028-01-17.
  - Ravi: Coordinate with GTM to prioritize customers for reserved capacity outreach (list and recommended SKU). Due: 2028-01-16.

Notes & context (working thoughts):
  - We observed that customer sandboxes can create pathological long-context patterns because they replay test suites; consider a sandbox mode that enforces shorter max_input_tokens and dedicated ephemeral cache buckets. (brainstorm: sandbox-mode enforcement flag in customer config)
  - The batching regression surfaced only when batch size distribution shifted; suggests telemetry for per-batch-size error rates would be valuable. Add to telemetry backlog.
  - Trace retention change will save ~14% on observability spend but will increase time-to-resolution for some incidents; mitigate with a curated 30-day opt-in for paid enterprise customers.

Parking lot / follow-ups (not for this meeting):
  - Evaluate controlled warm-pool experiment for tail latency improvements (cross-org research ticket).
  - Long-term: better per-customer shaping controls in the ingress router to protect shared pools.

Next meeting: 2028-01-16 10:00 PT
Proposed pre-reads: runtime canary dashboard link, JIRA-INF-2345 RCA draft (if available), quantization rollout plan doc.

Document history: created 2028-01-09 by Ava Martinez; notes updated 2028-01-10 by Marcus Chen with canary reduction decision and new action items.

-- end of notes --
summary: Weekly cross-team leads bridge capturing latency spike in us-west-2, batching regression signals in runtime PR #981, autoscaler misreporting blocker, decisions to reduce canary and require short-tail microbench for quantized rollouts, and a set of targeted action items.
